content:
Every equation question is secretly a balance puzzle: what you do to one side, you must do to the other. Once a child truly believes that, Simple Equations becomes the most reliable chapter on the paper. The free IMO Class 7 Linear Equations online test below has 10 exam-pattern MCQs with instant scoring. Treat it as a diagnostic. Every explanation tells you what to revise.

What the IMO asks from Linear Equations in Class 7

  • Solving ax + b = c and bracket equations like 3(2x − 1) = 4x + 7.
  • Variables on both sides.
  • Framing equations from word problems (ages, money, perimeter).
  • Checking solutions by substitution.
  • Fraction coefficients: x/3 + x/4 = 7.

Key facts and formulas to revise first

  • Transposing = moving a term across the equals sign with its operation inverted.
  • Multiply out brackets FIRST, then collect x-terms on one side.
  • For x/3 + x/4 = 7, multiply through by 12 — fractions vanish instantly.
  • Always substitute your answer back: 10 seconds to guarantee the mark.

Mistakes that cost Olympiad marks

  • Changing signs of only some terms when transposing.
  • Distributing 3(2x − 1) as 6x − 1.
  • Solving word problems without defining what x stands for.

questions.q: The difference between two positive integers is 45, and one integer is four times the other. The larger integer is:
questions.explanation: Let the smaller be x; the larger is 4x. 4x − x = 45, so 3x = 45 and x = 15. Larger integer = 4 × 15 = 60.

questions.q: A father's age is three times the sum of his two children's ages. After 5 years, it will be twice that sum. The father's present age is:
questions.explanation: Children's sum x, father 3x. After 5 years the sum becomes x + 10 and 3x + 5 = 2(x + 10). x = 15, so father = 45 years.

questions.q: A purse holds Rs. 300 in Re. 1, Rs. 2 and Rs. 5 coins. Rs. 2 coins are three times the Re. 1 coins; Rs. 5 coins equal the Re. 1 coins. The total number of coins is:
questions.explanation: Coins: x, 3x, x. Value: x + 6x + 5x = 12x = 300. x = 25, so total coins = 5x = 125.

questions.q: A person drives a distance at 40 km/h and returns at 60 km/h, taking 5 hours in all. The one-way distance is:
In a two-digit number the tens digit is twice the units digit. Subtracting 36 interchanges the digits. The number is:
questions.explanation: Units x, tens 2x: number = 21x. 21x − 36 = 12x, so 9x = 36 and x = 4. The number is 84.
